entries.label: MGS3 — Svyatogornyj East
entries.prompt: Generate exactly ONE wide 16:9 empty fighting-stage background source for CQC Versus Legacy. Faithfully adapt the attached screenshots of Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater (2004 PlayStation 2, NOT Delta) into finely painted HD 2D scenery. Retain location-specific architecture, military era, materials and the original yellow-green wooded lighting. No people, enemies, HUD, writing, logos, watermarks or collage. Continuous level horizontal fighting floor across the lower quarter. This is one whole static source, not fake parallax layers. SVYATOGORNYJ EAST: the quiet remote log-and-plank supply cabin in the eastern forest. The first reference is the exact exterior: weathered grey-brown timber walls, raised wooden porch, simple horizontal handrail, short stairs at the left, wooden military crate on the porch, large close broadleaf tree trunk beside the cabin. Second reference shows the wood plank texture and storage crates inside only; do NOT turn the scene into an indoor room. Wide side view of the cabin facade, porch and neighboring trunks, dense cool mossy woodland beyond, dappled olive forest light and muddy leaf-covered clearing. A level natural dirt lane across foreground, no sniper scope vignette or people, no modern buildings.

notes: Identity, original edition, palette and defining structures checked against the listed game screenshots.
Wide painted combat view includes composition and hidden-detail adaptation; strict 1:1 certification remains pending.
Static source only; not admitted to runtime, no animated layers or collision geometry.
